decisive_items: no fluctuance, purulence, or visible pilonidal pits
response.rationale: Chronic slow-growing subcutaneous mass near the coccyx without acute inflammation, pilonidal pits, or aspirated fluid favors an inclusion/epidermoid cyst; pilonidal cyst is contradicted, and soft-tissue tumor is a broad nonspecific differential.

rejected.why: Broad nonspecific category; only listed in the differential and less specific than epidermoid cyst.
Duplicate of R1 with the same label and support; no additional discriminating evidence.
Contradicted by absence of pilonidal pits, no fluctuance/purulence, and dry aspiration; lacks acute inflammatory features.
